prompt: Who was the Argentinian president who resigned from the position the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated?
answer: The president was **Pedro Pablo Ramírez**, Argentina’s de facto president, who resigned on **June 9, 1944**. The José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated earlier that year, on **April 15, 1944**.
